name: sshi_fbr
rationale: The reference FBR failed because the piezo's open-circuit voltage (approx 0.76 V) is below the required 1.8 V output. I am implementing a Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit. This uses an inductor and a switch to flip the voltage across the piezo capacitance at every peak, effectively 'pumping' the voltage to a higher level that can then be rectified and stored. A full-bridge rectifier (FBR) is used for efficient energy extraction from both halves of the cycle, and a Zener diode clamps the output to 3.3 V to satisfy the vmax limit.
